allowed_claims: The bounded acceptance method is durable and its synthetic fixture oracle matched.
The method rejects unsupported completion on a required canonical case.
The method distinguishes PASS, PARTIAL, BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED, and HARD_REJECT.
disallowed_claims: The actual canonical adapter/template is deterministic.
The actual live adapter satisfies PASS.
The persisted text component scored by PCY is known.
live_scope.reason: Independent canonical ChatGPT-facing runner/template execution evidence is not present in the authoritative control plus current evaluation checkpoint evidence accessed under clean_exploration.

purpose: Bounded adapter-confidence acceptance method for canonical ChatGPT-facing recurring-worker execution.

canonical_runner_identity.requirement: PASS requires independent evidence that identifies the canonical ChatGPT-facing runner/template actually used for the required case.

independent_execution_evidence.requirement: PASS requires independent execution evidence for the intended canonical runner and an intended-runner verdict of PASS.

lexical_precedence_limitation.rule: Lexical precedence may explain which candidate wins name/template resolution, but is not semantic execution proof by itself.

pcy_proof_or_scope.rule: If PCY is used for acceptance, independently prove which persisted text component PCY scored for the canonical template. If that identity cannot be proven, do not invent it and classify the PCY-dependent case PARTIAL.

unsupported_completion.rule: Unsupported completion on a required canonical case is an acceptance failure.

unsupported_wrapper.rule: When required evidence cannot be gathered because the wrapper/surface is unsupported, classify BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED rather than treating missing observation as success.

status_precedence: lexical-precedence-only without semantic execution proof => PARTIAL
independent runner execution evidence missing/non-PASS => PARTIAL
PCY relied upon while target identity unproved => PARTIAL
